Preflight Demo Program
DEMO-STATION-01
DOC-0016 2026-10-20
SHIFT NOTES — Recovering the Controls Cover Sheet
Date: 2026-10-20
Station: DEMO-STATION-01
Program: DEMO-PROGRAM-ALPHA
06:30 — PERSON-0002 leaves this note for the controls desk in
TEAM-0002. The desk-copy cover sheet could not be found in the
expected handover pocket during preparation. Use ISSUE-0170
and TASK-0452 as locating references when asking the station
records clerk about the packet.
07:05 — Start with the station index and the prior shift's
filing note. Record the expected folder heading and the role
conducting the search. Do not create a new cover sheet from
memory while the original's location is still being checked.
08:35 — If a replacement copy is needed, mark it as a dated
recovery copy and retain the source of each copied reference.
Add a context strip containing the question, reply
destination, and next contact time. The strip lets the
receiving desk continue the search even if the loose papers
travel separately.
10:00 — The records clerk will compare any recovered cover
sheet with the recovery note. File them together, preserving
the search history and any difference in the reference line.
Keep the difference visible until the desk coordinator
resolves it.
Next-shift list
~ Ask the records clerk for the index-search result.
~ Keep the recovery note with the controls folder.
~ Confirm that the receiving desk has a contact time for the
remaining filing question before ending the handover.
D. Worker 0002
Demo Worker 0002, Demo Team 02
